cues.text: In 1731, the Venerable Sister Maria Celeste Crostarosa founded a new contemplative community at Scala, in the hills above Amalfi in southern Italy, which would become the cradle of the Redemptoristine order.
Eucharistic adoration stood at the center of the community's daily life, with the Blessed Sacrament exposed for veneration each Thursday.
Beginning in September 1732, those present at the Thursday expositions began to report something extraordinary appearing within the consecrated Host itself.
For more than three consecutive months, they saw the cross, the scourges, the crown of thorns, and other instruments associated with Christ's Passion during the periods of adoration.

Among those who witnessed the phenomenon directly was Alphonsus Maria de Liguori, who happened to be at Scala during these very months working with Bishop Thomas Falcoia and Sister Crostarosa to establish a new religious congregation.

In November 1732, in the midst of the reported apparitions, Liguori formally founded the Congregation of the Most Holy Redeemer — the Redemptorists — a foundation many at the time read as confirmed by the Eucharistic signs unfolding around it.
The phenomenon was attested not only by the resident nuns but also by priests and lay faithful who traveled from across the Amalfi coast to witness it.
Two bishops — the Bishop of Scala and the Bishop of Castellammare — also attested to it, lending the account a formal ecclesiastical weight unusual for a private-adoration vision of this kind.
The Monastery of the Most Holy Redeemer at Scala remains, today, both the birthplace of the Redemptoristine order and the site associated with the 1732 Eucharistic signs.
Local tradition treats this dual identity as inseparable: the community's founding and the accompanying extraordinary events read as two expressions of the same underlying grace.

The monstrance used during the original expositions is preserved at the monastery, a direct physical link between Liguori's own foundational moment and the phenomenon he and others reported witnessing alongside it.
